exposure: Cortisol status during pregnancy (eucortisolism, hypocortisolism, hypercortisolism)
cortisolic status at the time of pregnancy
cohort: 60 pregnant women with a history of Cushing's disease followed in French tertiary referral centers
finding: Women with a history of Cushing's disease who are not eucortisolic during pregnancy have an increased risk of prematurity and comorbidities like gestational diabetes and hypertension.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was high (33.7%) in the whole cohort, emphasizing the high-risk nature of these pregnancies.
